name: Axiom Shadow Drone
description: A stealth surveillance drone invisible to standard sensors and nearly invisible to the naked eye — matte-black, whisper-quiet, the size of a raven. Shadows operate in classified numbers throughout GLMZ, and no one outside Axiom's security directorate knows how many are overhead at any given moment. They don't carry weapons. They carry something worse: information. A Shadow has been watching you, and you will never know unless Axiom wants you to.
capacity: Sensor payload only — cameras, LIDAR, signal intercept, biometric scan
range: 12 hours endurance, automated recharge at concealed stations
armament: None. Observation only. The follow-up is someone else's job.
common_usage: Covert surveillance, intelligence gathering, target tracking, mapping dissident networks.
story_hooks: A freelancer catches a Shadow drone on a modified sensor sweep and realizes they can track Axiom's surveillance patterns — information worth killing for
A Shadow drone crashes in The Shelf and the data on its memory core reveals surveillance of someone inside Axiom's own leadership
related_entities: Tethered Orbital Reconnaissance and Suppression Drone TORSD-7 'Kitestring'
physical_description: A matte-black quadcopter no larger than a raven, its chassis molded from composite polymers scarred by industrial particulate. Four rotors barely disturb the air, their edges serrated to shear sound into white noise. A single lens, obsidian and recessed, sits flush with the fuselage—no glint, no reflection, just absence.
